acceptance: A single-mode platform accepts `name:<its only mode>` and records it, and rejects any other mode. CLI and MCP tests cover this.
A parity test asserts that every option or alias named in `docs/platforms/*.md` option tables exists in the registry or the alias table.
Platform docs examples select deployment with the `platform:mode` selector, not the deprecated `deployment_mode` option
context:
Follow-ups from #2974, #2980 and #2995. The alias table is `DEPRECATED_OPTION_ALIASES`, and the deployment alias keys are derived from it (ADR D12). Alias half closed by #3020 on 2026-10-16; MCP is fail-closed and does not expose InfluxDB/LakeSail deployment_mode.

2026-10-17: Python callers can now select a mode with `DatabaseConfig(type="platform:mode")` (#3066, b7e364ad8), and the examples use it. `docs/platforms/influxdb.md` still shows the deprecated `deployment_mode` in its Python examples (lines 99, 107, 167).
description:
Platforms that declare a single deployment mode do not accept the `name:mode` selector, even with their own mode. Scripts that pass the selector for every platform fail.

The InfluxDB and LakeSail alias-table gap (`deployment_mode` missing from `DEPRECATED_OPTION_ALIASES`) and the matching docs rows were fixed in PR #3020 (merge 926199a695cf964552f3087ebe0e2bcafc9044a2), with a registry-walk test. Remaining: the single-mode selector, and a general parity test between registered option specs and the platform docs.
